steps.name: Epilogue ~ Bait
steps.objective: Listen to the story of the two men in a quiet place in “Deborah Snowfield” and press the quest completion button.

lines.text: (In a secluded place in the Deborah snowfield, two men in mismatched clothing are shaking snow off their clothes.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's annoying... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: There seems to be no more trace of snakes on this continent. That was the last time I met Lethe... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The snake is sneaky and must have hid somewhere.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why are you smiling?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I was just curious.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: How you felt as you looked at that child's beginning and end, a new beginning... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Became the master of this world... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Stop it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: As the blood of the Der people created by the goddess Ceres faded, their descendants lived as ordinary humans.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Awakening was rare, but we still chased those with Der's blood and died.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now that I think about it, that guy also comes to mind. Hehe, laughing and moving along with the wizard without even knowing it was a god... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Anyway, you are still denying yourself. All that has happened to you now... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Just one more word... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Why don't you know you can't do it?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Cough, Cough, Cluck, Cluck… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Ugh… … .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… .
(Kazno loses consciousness after continuous coughing and collapses into the snow.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Foolish Kazno… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You can survive if you give up what you were doing for that child. What is that child to you that even death can withstand?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Asking to chase a snake, pulling out a witch who was playing around, revealing that she was just like us… everything. .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, what you did for that child… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: But since when have you been here?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ah… ?
(While Jeril is supporting Kazno, he makes eye contact with a girl. When Jeril looks at her with a smile, the girl steps back as if embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (Eyes of different colors… armor… I think I’ve seen it somewhere…)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: There's no need to be scared. All you have to do is tell who you are and where you come from.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why am I here? Who are you?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I hid so that Weiss couldn't find me, so how did they find me?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: No, why am I in Eastland? I was in Glaston a little while ago... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Vice? It's not normal to run away from a criminal. I don’t think it’s Agashura either… .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Compare me to Agashura? Please don't do that. Phew… . I thought it would be easy to have a new god in this land... .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Let’s not see each other again… . Wolf Boy. No, mister.
(The girl looks around and hurries to follow the snow.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: To be so easily ignored... . Agashura I don't like showing off, but I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'll give you a gift.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Stop.
(Jeril's low murmur reaches the girl's ears. The girl feels her body not moving for a moment, but laughs lightly.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Are you Agashura? I don't want to get involved, so let's break up like this.
(Jeril chuckles as the girl stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe, that's fun. It must not have been light at all, but seeing it break and move is not normal. then… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: No. I'll send it to you. Anyway, if that's the case, we'll meet someday.
(Without Jeril having time to say anything, the girl disappears into the snowstorm in the distance, and Jeril starts laughing maniacally in place.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hahahaha... . Hahahaha, hahahahaha!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Okay… . what?
(Kazno comes to his senses and looks up at Jeril, who makes eye contact with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, rejoice. Because bait has appeared for Ouroboros to swallow.
